Subject: Packaging question: advanced dashboards + retention credits

Hi Sofia,

Quick follow-up from our call this morning — thanks for walking us through the runtime and the latency guarantees. Two procurement questions we need line-of-sight on before we take this to procurement:

1) Advanced dashboards: we run ~120 dashboards, ~18 power users and ~200 viewers. Can you share the recommended SKUs for a customer this size? We want to understand seat-based vs. flat SKU economics and whether you can separate dashboard licensing from storage charges.

2) Retention and tracing: we need 90–365 day retention for traces and logs. What are the pricing levers? Is retention strictly per-GB-month, or do you offer tiered credits / pre-purchased storage that can be consumed across traces and dashboards?

3) Discounts & commits: Acme is open to a multi-year commit if unit economics line up. What discount bands do you offer for 12/24 month commitments and are there up-front credit packages for the first 12 months?

If you can send a simple SKU/price sheet and an example invoice (we have to show these to our finance team), that would be helpful. We can share our usage profile if that helps.

Thanks — I can bring procurement on a quick call next week if needed.

Best,
Jemma
Head of Data Products
Acme Analytics

Hi Jemma — great speaking this morning. Thanks for the usage file; that helped. Below is a concise packaging option we see working well for customers of your size. I’ve kept bullets so you can drop these into your procurement packet.

Proposal (summary):
- Dashboards Pro (seat-oriented): 18 Power seats + 200 Viewer seats. Pricing guidance: seat-based MSRP with two purchase choices — per-seat annual or seat bundle commit. Example: $200/seat/mo (power) list; tiered volume discounts apply.
- Storage & Retention (hybrid): Per-GB-month for cold storage; a retention credit SKU that can be pre-purchased and applied across dashboard snapshots and trace storage. Tiers: 0–5TB, 5–20TB, 20TB+ with stepped pricing.
- Tracing: charged as a combination of ingest (per million spans) + retained bytes. Sampled traces reduce ingest charge; we can provide an auto-sampler to control spend without losing signal.

Discount / commit suggestions:
- 12 month commit: 18% off list on combined Dashboards + Retention if commit >= $120k ARR.
- 24 month commit: 25% off list and a one-time retention credit applied to the first billing cycle (we typically offer 200k GB-month credits for 24-months at an enterprise tier; amount can be negotiated).

Pilot concession: for the proof-of-value we can offer a 3-month pilot credit (equivalent to $8k of retention credits + 2 free power seats) to accelerate evaluation.

Next steps: I’m attaching a concise terms-summary and a sample invoice showing how the credits and seat discounts flow through. If this looks acceptable I’ll loop Ben for pricing approval and Marissa for a tailored SOW + DocuSign.

Attaching: terms-summary.pdf, sample-invoice.xlsx

If you want, we can sketch a 24-month committed path with an adjusted credit level — I’ll confirm internally once you indicate a preference.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova

Hi Jemma — thanks for the patience while we finalized internal approvals. Below are the preliminary commercial terms we can put into a quote for procurement review. This is intended to be a concise summary before we prepare an SOW + DocuSign packet.

Summary of agreed preliminary terms
- Commitment: 24 months (ACME-2027-009).
- Dashboards Pro: 18 Power seats (licensed) + 200 Viewer seats. 20% off list for Dashboards Pro for the 24-month commit (conditional on usage milestones at month 6 and 12).
- Retention credits: 250k GB-month one-time credit applied across dashboards snapshots & trace storage during year one. Post-credit consumption billed at tiered per-GB-month rates (0–5TB, 5–20TB, 20TB+).
- Tracing: base rate applies for ingest (per million spans) with a 10% discount applied for the commitment. Auto-sampler recommended to control ingestion economics.
- Pilot concession: 3-month pilot credit (equivalent to $8k in retention credits + 2 complimentary Power seats) — applies if signed within 30 days.
- Legal/SOW: credit exhaustion language and milestone conditions to be documented in the SOW.

Attached is the updated quote (acme-quote-v2.pdf) and a DocuSign link to a draft MSA/Order Form (docusign-acme-quote-link.txt). The DocuSign envelope contains redlines for milestone-based discounts and a retention credit schedule.

If this matches your expectations we’ll issue a formal SOW and route through DocuSign for signature. If procurement wants an alternate credit structure (e.g., larger upfront credit in exchange for an earlier payment schedule) we can model that quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.
